name: Brenai (Wizra)
what: Companion life-sim at brenai.fly.dev. The player talks with Wizra (22, goth, D&D, college student) who has a 3D VRM body, voice, dorm, schedule, moods, memory and a relationship that grows through romance levels. Her words come from the PC model through a bridge; the game supplies everything around them.
where: Live: https://brenai.fly.dev (deploys on push to main touching brenai/, workflow brenai-deploy.yml)
Data: Fly volume brenai_data at /data (3 GB): per-player saves, shared.json, avatar.vrm, anims.json, outfits/, pack/, inbox/
stack: Node, one server file (server.mjs), no build step, no framework
Plain browser modules, three.js and three-vrm vendored in public/vendor
PC model MN-Violet-Lotus-12B in Bionic on an RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB, reached by bridge/wizra-bridge.mjs
Kokoro voice on the PC (kokoro-js, 28 voices), browser voices as fallback
Claude claude-opus-5-5 only as a backup when the PC is offline and a key is set
MediaPipe pose, face and hand trackers on the mocap page

tools.name: Wizra bridge (bridge/wizra-bridge.mjs, start-wizra.ps1)
tools.what: Connects the PC model and voice out to the server
tools.use_when: Anything that needs her words or voice; the hub worker talks to the same Bionic server

tools.name: Studio (public/dev.html)
tools.what: Layout editor, scripted events, room maps, character and rules, outfits
tools.use_when: Changing her character, rules, rooms, events or layout WITHOUT code

tools.name: Mocap page (public/mocap.html, mocap.js)
tools.what: Camera, video and photo motion capture to her clip format, face, fingers, tongue
tools.use_when: A motion only Andrew can act out

tools.name: Clip converter (tools/clipconv.mjs)
tools.what: Mixamo FBX (without skin) to her clip JSON

tools.name: Picture pack (tools/picpack)
tools.what: Renders about a hundred ready pictures she can send

settings.name: CONTEXT_TOKENS
settings.note: PC model context; WIZRA_CONTEXT on the PC must match

settings.name: Other env
settings.value: REPLY_TOKENS, USER_NAME, MODEL, EFFORT, COMPACT_AT, LEARN_EVERY, SESSION_SECRET
settings.note: test switches: AWAY_SPEED, AWAY_TEST_LIE, CALL_TEST_RING, PIC_TEST, VISIT_TEST, WANDER_TEST
